title: Perennial crash-aware locked critical section
summary: The crash-lock specification composes lock acquisition, a WPC-governed critical section and release while preserving the declared normal and crash postconditions.
proof_system: Rocq with Iris, Perennial crash logic and Goose

source.statement: Lemma with_lock_spec Φ Φc (R Rcrash : iProp Σ) lk e : to_val e = None → is_crash_lock lk R Rcrash ∗ (Φc ∧ (R -∗ WPC e @ ⊤ {{ λ v, (Φc ∧ Φ #()) ∗ R }} {{ Φc ∗ Rcrash }})) -∗ WPC (with_lock lk e) @ ⊤ {{ Φ }} {{ Φc }}.

assumptions: The statement is in the crash-lock proof section with heapGS Σ, stagedG Σ and lock namespace Nlock. The expression must satisfy to_val e = None. The is_crash_lock predicate stores crash_borrow R Rcrash in the mutex invariant. The critical section must establish Φc ∧ Φ #() and restore R on normal completion, or establish Φc ∗ Rcrash on a crash.

license.attribution: Tej Chajed; repository owner and pinned commit author

reuse: Import Perennial.goose_lang.lib.lock.crash_lock from the pinned repository and provide the underlying Iris/Perennial crash-logic and Goose modules. Establish is_crash_lock lk R Rcrash and the stated WPC for e, then apply with_lock_spec. The lower-level use_crash_locked lemma exposes the crash borrow around an arbitrary non-value expression; with_lock_spec additionally sequences acquire and release.
